subject: Tidewater Bank RFI: TAM coverage, escalation & incident communications
messages:
From: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@tidewaterbank.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tidewaterbank.com; Markus Bianchi <markus.bianchi@tidewaterbank.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 21:08:00 -0400
Subject: RFI: Support coverage, TAM model, and incident comms

Hi Camila,

Thanks for taking our RFI. As part of our procurement packet we need a detailed response on your support model and TAM coverage. Specifically we’d like:

- A table of TAM roles, hours covered (local timezone), escalation path for P1/P2 incidents, and expected response/acknowledgement SLAs.
- Example incident communications templates (initial alert, status updates, incident close).
- Pager/integration capabilities (PagerDuty, Opsgenie), and whether Redwood will integrate with our existing on-call.
- After-hours/on-call rotation details and any extra-cost items for 24x7 coverage.
- Contact and escalation info for exec-level support and legal/incident reporting.

Our procurement timeline: RFP responses due by 2027-08-03; we’d like a short walk-through next week if possible. Please send any attachments as PDFs or spreadsheets.

Regards,
Lynn Cho
Procurement Lead
Tidewater Bank

--
Attachment requests: please include any runbooks or templates you typically provide to enterprise customers.

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
To: Lynn Cho <lynn.cho@tidewaterbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Support coverage, TAM model, and incident comms

Hi Lynn — thanks for the clear ask. Attached are the artifacts you requested: a TAM coverage table, incident comms templates, and a concise SLA & on-call summary. Highlights below so procurement can scan quickly: 

- TAM coverage: Named TAM included in Dedicated and Private tiers; typical coverage is 8am–6pm local business days (customer timezone) with 4-hour response for P2s during business hours. 24x7 coverage is available as an add-on with a 60-minute P1 acknowledgement SLA. (See attached spreadsheet).
- Escalation path: TAM -> Support Engineering -> Incident Lead -> On-call Engineering Manager -> Head of Support. For SLAs and executive escalation we provide a documented contact chain and a 1-hour exec notif window for Sev1s when 24x7 is enabled.
- Integrations: We support PagerDuty & Opsgenie out of the box; we can provide the integration playbook and sample webhook mapping.
- Incident comms: Templates included (Initial, Hourly Status, Root Cause Summary). We can insert your company metadata and deliver via whichever channel you prefer (email, Slack webhook, or status page).

Next steps: we can schedule a 30-min runbook walk-through with Aditya (SE) to show how integrations and escalation automation work. Proposed slots: Tue 07/27 10:00–12:00 ET or Wed 07/28 14:00–16:00 ET. Which works for you?

Attachments: Redwood_TAM_Coverage_Table.xlsx, Incident_Comms_Templates.docx, SLA_Oncall_Summary_2027.pdf

Best,
Camila Reyes
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: RFI: Support coverage, TAM model, and incident comms

Lynn / Camila — quick technical clarifications from the SE side that we should include in the RFI response: 

- PagerDuty integration: we offer both inbound (Redwood -> PD incidents via API) and outbound (PD -> Redwood via webhook). Standard mapping available; advanced field mappings are configurable during onboarding.
- On-call model: for 24x7 we deploy a two-layer rotation: primary on-call (first-touch) and escalation on-call (engineering resolver). Primary handles ack/triage; escalation on-call handles code-level remediation. We supply runbooks and can host them in your Confluence or in our shared S3 bucket.
- Monitoring hooks: we can send structured JSON status updates (incidents) every 15 minutes, and provide an hourly human-readable update when requested.
- Costs: 24x7 coverage is a line item; runbook customization and playbook run-throughs are billable hours beyond the included onboarding package.

I attached a short snippet of a runbook (included inside the Incident_Comms_Templates docx). Happy to demo the PD integration in the walkthrough.

—Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Hi Lynn — following up with the meeting invite and attachments embedded here. I also pasted a short P1 escalation flow below for quick reference. 

P1 escalation (summary):
1) Incident detected / reported -> Primary on-call acknowledges within 60 minutes (for customers with 24x7).
2) If unresolved after 30 minutes -> Escalation on-call engaged.
3) If unresolved after 90 minutes -> Incident Lead + TAM notified; Exec notif sent within 1 hour of elevated impact.

Attachments uploaded to Drive and enclosed as PDFs. DocuSign link for the standard SOW addendum (if you’d like to add 24x7) is here: https://docusign.net/REDW-TO-TWB-SOW-3321

Meeting options: Tue 07/27 10:30 ET (walkthrough + PD demo) or Wed 07/28 14:00 ET. I’ll hold the 10:30 slot for now and will cancel if you prefer the later one.

Best,

Redwood Inference
